enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast from the toaster and tea from the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Take out tea bag. Close refrigerator. Plug in toaster. Insert bread into toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Pour tea into cup. Add milk. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Clean up. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing university laptop and notes, and checking the day's class timetable on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Put on clothes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open timetable app. Check class schedule. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Turn off light. Leave bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on with Myki card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Tap on. Find seat. Sit down. Get off train. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a business lecture at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open notes. Take notes. Raise hand to ask question. Write answer. Close laptop. Pack bag. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying course readings in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Enter library. Find empty desk. Sit down. Open bag. Take out textbook. Open textbook. Read pages. Highlight text. Take notes. Use laptop to search for references. Close textbook. Pack bag. Stand up. Leave library.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and catching up with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Join classmates. Say hello. Sit down. Open lunchbox. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk with classmates. Laugh. Finish eating. Throw away trash. Stand up. Say goodbye. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a tutorial and working through case study exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Enter tutorial room. Sit down. Open notebook. Write answers. Discuss with group. Raise hand. Ask question. Work on case study. Present findings. Pack bag. Leave room.

enriched_activities.activity: Meeting a group for a marketing group assignment
enriched_activities.desc: Meet group in library. Sit at table. Open laptop. Share ideas. Assign tasks. Take notes. Set deadline. Close laptop. Pack bag. Say goodbye. Leave.

enriched_activities.activity: Revising notes and checking the retail roster on the phone before heading home
enriched_activities.desc: Find quiet spot. Sit down. Open notebook. Review notes. Highlight key points. Take out phone. Unlock phone. Open roster app. Check shifts. Note schedule. Lock phone. Pack bag. Stand up. Walk to bus stop.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from Clayton by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Tap on. Find seat. Sit down. Get off train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Reheating a pre-cooked meal in the microwave to avoid using the induction cooker during the 5pm-8pm peak cooking period
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out pre-cooked meal. Close refrigerator. Open microwave door. Place meal inside. Close door. Set timer. Press start. Wait for microwave. Open microwave door. Take out meal. Close door. Turn off light. Leave kitchen.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat meal. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table. Stand up. Leave kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Stand up. Turn off TV. Leave living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on assignments and online coursework on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open assignment file. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Read online material. Take notes. Save file. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off light. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Wipe face. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the fan on, scrolling the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll social media. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:45. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
